5. File server attachment serving — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677-699` (checkAttachmentPermission validates memo visibility)

6. Notification/email system (two locations) — `server/notification/email.go:313-316` (checks before sending notifications) and `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312` (GetNotifications filters by visibility)

7. RSS feed generation — `server/router/rss/rss.go` (filters to public memos only)
